ड्रग फ्री मुंबईसाठी प्रत्येक घटकाचा सहभाग आवश्यक मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांच्या हस्ते आज मुंबई येथे 'ड्रग फ्री मुंबई' या नशामुक्ती जनजागृती अभियानाचा शुभारंभ करण्यात आला. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, पंतप्रधान नरेंद्र मोदी यांनी 'नशामुक्त भारताचा' संकल्प केला आहे. हा संकल्प पूर्ण करण्यासाठी आपण सर्वांनी एकत्र येऊन 'ड्रग फ्री मुंबई' आणि 'ड्रग फ्री महाराष्ट्र' करणे आवश्यक आहे. भारत हा जगातील सर्वाधिक युवा लोकसंख्या असलेला देश असून ही तरुणाईच विकसित भारताची सर्वात मोठी ताकद आहे. हीच युवा पिढी उद्याचा भारत घडविणार असून, त्यांना योग्य दिशा मिळाल्यास भारत जगाचा मार्गदर्शक ठरेल. भारताला आमनेसामने लढाईत पराभूत करणे शक्य नसल्याने, देशाला आतून कमकुवत करण्यासाठी तरुणाईला अमली पदार्थांच्या विळख्यात अडकविण्याचे छुपे षडयंत्र रचले जात आहे. दुर्दैवाने, पैशाच्या मोहापोटी देशातील काही घटकही या कारवायांमध्ये सहभागी होत असून, त्यांचा वापर करून हे षडयंत्र अधिक बळकट करण्याचा प्रयत्न केला जात असल्याचे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी नमूद केले. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, ड्रगविरोधातील ही लढाई केवळ पोलीस प्रशासनाची नसून आरोग्य, सामाजिक न्याय, शालेय शिक्षण विभाग, शिक्षक, विद्यार्थी, पालक आणि समाजातील प्रत्येक घटकाला याविरोधात सामूहिक युद्ध सुरू करावे लागेल. ड्रग्जचा पुरवठा, उत्पादन आणि तस्करीविरोधात सरकारकडून कठोर कारवाई केली जात असली तरी समाजाच्या सक्रिय सहभागाशिवाय हे अभियान यशस्वी होणार नाही. महाराष्ट्राचे आराध्य दैवत छत्रपती शिवाजी महाराज यांच्या गनिमी काव्याच्या माध्यमातून ड्रग माफियांचे संपूर्ण जाळे उद्ध्वस्त करावे लागणार आहे. यासाठी ड्रगची विक्री, पुरवठा किंवा व्यसनाधीनतेबाबतची माहिती तात्काळ प्रशासनापर्यंत पोहोचवावी, ही माहिती देणाऱ्यांची ओळख पूर्णपणे गोपनीय ठेवली जाईल, तसेच भविष्यात त्यांना पुरस्कार देऊन गौरवण्यात येईल, असे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यावेळी नमूद केले. भारताची युवा पिढी हा देश चालवणार आहे. हेच युवा भविष्यातील डॉक्टर, इंजिनिअर, वैज्ञानिक आहेत. त्यामुळे ड्रग विरोधात विद्यार्थ्यांचा ठाम निर्धार आवश्यक आहे. शाळा, महाविद्यालये आणि विद्यापीठे ही 'ड्रग फ्री मुंबई' अभियानाचे नेत्र असून विद्यार्थ्यांमध्ये जागरूकता निर्माण करण्यासाठी शैक्षणिक संस्थांची भूमिका अत्यंत महत्त्वाची आहे. तसेच युवकांनी 'Say No to Drugs' हा संकल्प करून कोणत्याही आमिषाला किंवा दबावाला बळी न पडता अमली पदार्थांना ठाम नकार द्यावा. ड्रगविरोधात सर्वांनी मिळून काम केल्यास पुढील 3 ते 4 वर्षांत 'ड्रग फ्री मुंबई', 'ड्रग फ्री महाराष्ट्र' आणि 'नशामुक्त भारत' साकार होईल, असे प्रतिपादन मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी केले. यावेळी मंत्री मंगलप्रभात लोढा व इतर मान्यवर उपस्थित होते. 【買取業務に関するご報告とお詫び】 本日、当店にて買取をご利用いただいたお客様より、「提出したカードが足りない」とのご指摘をいただきました。お客様は7枚提出されたとお申し出いただきましたが、当店側では当時5枚しか確認できず、査定担当者も「そのカードは見ていない」と回答いたしました。 その後、受付担当が防犯カメラの映像確認を提案し、査定担当者が該当の映像を確認。映っていた場面を写真で撮影し、お客様に提示いたしましたが、その映像には5枚しか映っていないように見えました。 その時点で受付担当は「映像で5枚しか確認できないため、納得いただけない場合は警察を呼んでご確認いただいた方が良いのでは」とお伝えしました。この発言はお客様への不信を前提としたものではありませんでしたが、結果として高圧的に受け取られかねないものであり、深く反省しております。 一度はお客様より「納得した」とのお言葉をいただきましたが、その数時間後「やはり足りないので再確認してほしい」とのご連絡をいただきました。PSAの鑑定番号も添えていただき、改めてより広い範囲の映像を確認したところ、お客様が査定物を出す準備の段階において、確かに7枚のカードをお出しになっていたことが確認されました。 結果として、査定担当者が7枚中5枚のみを査定し、残りの2枚を誤って査定済み用のケースに収納していたことが原因であったことが判明しました。このミスにより、お客様に不信感とご迷惑をおかけしてしまったことを、深くお詫び申し上げます。 今回の件では以下のような点が、お客様の信頼を損なう結果につながってしまいました： ①防犯映像が5枚に見えたという理由のみで、お客様のご申告を否定してしまったこと （映像には角度や映り方による限界があり、確定的な判断材料とすべきではありませんでした） ②「警察を呼びますか」といった対応が、誠実さではなく威圧と受け取られるような表現になってしまったこと ③映像確認の範囲が不十分で、カード提出の準備段階を確認していなかったこと （結果として「十分に確認もしていないのに、否定された」と感じさせてしまった可能性があります） お客様の大切なお品物をお預かりする立場として、あるまじき対応だったと真摯に受け止めております。 今後は以下のような再発防止策を徹底し、同様のことが起こらぬよう努めてまいります。 ・査定時のカード枚数を受付・査定・返却の各段階で必ず記録・照合 ・映像確認は受付〜準備段階〜査定開始までを通して行うことを明文化 このたびは、お客様に多大なご不快とご心配をおかけし、誠に申し訳ございませんでした。 今後とも誠実な対応と改善に努めてまいります。

When Bashar, a young pharmacist and dabke dancer from Gaza, boarded a medical evacuation flight last summer, his doctors were not sure if they could save his shattered leg. After four surgeries, including a bone graft to reconstruct his tibia, his surgeon has authorized a gradual return to weight-bearing. Bashar performed a chair dance in Paris, then danced again in Bobigny, on his crutches – reconnecting with the art he loves. He has also been reunited with his father and younger brother, a source of strength on this long road to recovery, with one final surgery still ahead. My heartfelt thanks to France 🇫🇷 for receiving Bashar; the doctors and health workers in Rennes caring for him; Dr Catherine Le Scolan-Quéré for her steadfast advocacy; and the WHO colleagues and partners who helped make his evacuation possible. So at that time, we launched Phonepe Pulse back in September 2021 as an open data platform that is spatially interactive and it showcased various consumption patterns across time, geography and categories. Since then, many institutions have actually used data from Pulse to inform decisions and the users of these PhonePe Pulse has varied from enterprises to entrepreneurs to policymakers, think tanks. In fact, the most interesting use cases came when people took the PhonePe Pulse data and juxtaposed it or augmented it with other rich data sources and then provided very unique insights. World bank, for example, published a report back in 2023 where they talked about how the labor force has come back post the pandemic and specifically where have they come back, in what states, at what pace, and so on and that was again, juxtaposing their own data sets with PhonePe Pulse. Similarly, RBI published a report in 2025 that talked about the impact of UPI on cash demand. Another example is the Observer Research Foundation, ORF used Pulse data to derive various scenarios of India's growth when they were modeling out India's GDP forecast... Along the way, what we also realized is that some organisations want more. They want different kinds of data cuts. Some wanted more data cuts on geography. So while we provided district level data, some said, they want to see at a pin code level or at a 1km by 1km level... To meet this demand, we're very excited to launch Pulse Pro today because this offers a very granular data set that offers intelligence for a variety of stakeholders in a manner that's not available anywhere else. So it is this journey that has, made us launch Pulse Pro today." Video

شاہ رخ خان کے چچازاد بھائی اور غلام محمد گاما کے فرزند منصور احمد میرے کرکٹ کے ساتھی تھے۔ہم دونوں ایک ہی کلب(ینگ برادرز) سے کھیلتے تھے۔اس کے بقول وہ کشمیری ہیں۔اس کے دادا میر جان محمد روزگار کے سلسلے میں کشمیر سے نقل مکانی کرکے شاہ ولی قتال قصہ خوانی بازار میں رہائش پذیر ہوئے۔ان کا بانسوں کا کاروبار تھا۔منصور کے والد غلام محمد گاما خدائی خدمت گار تحریک سے وابستہ رہےاور اسی پاداش میں قید وبند کی صعوبتیں برداست کیں۔شاہ رخ خان کے والد تاج محمد بھائیوں میں سے چھوٹے تھے اور زمانہ طالبعلمی میں ہی بڑے بھائی کے ساتھ گرفتار ہوکر اڑھائی سال تک پابند سلاسل رہے۔جس کی وجہ سے ان کی تعلیم بھی متاثر ہوئی اور غالباً 1944 میں پرائیویٹ بی اے کا امتحان پاس کیا۔جس کے بعد وہ مزید تعلیم کے لیے دہلی گئے۔میرے والد مرحوم کے گاما صاحب کے ساتھ بڑے اچھے مراسم تھے۔ان کی بانسوں کی دکان چارسدہ روڈ اور شاہی باغ روڈ کے سنگم پر تھی۔حسن اتفاق سے شاہی باغ روڈپر عبدالقیوم خان کا بنگلہ بھی تھا۔یہ بھی شنید ہے کہ غلام محمد گاما اور عبدالقیوم خان میں بڑے اچھے تعلقات بھی تھے۔1988 میں منصور اور میں ایک کلب سے کھیلتے تھےوہ ہمیں اکثر شاہ رخ خان کے بارے میں بتایا کرتا تھا کہ میرا کزن بھارتی فلموں میں جلوہ گر ہوگا تو ہم اس کا مذاق اڑایا کرتے تھے۔لیکن کچھ عرصہ واقعی شاہ رخ خان کی فلمیں ریلیز ہونے لگیں۔منصور نے ایک بار ہمیں پورا البم دکھایا تھا جس میں شاہ رخ خان کے بچپن اور جوانی کی تصویریں تھیں۔ Hamid Mir حامد میر (@HamidMirPAK) حاجی غلام احمد بلور نے شاہ رخ خان کے والد تاج محمد خان کے بارے میں بتایا کہ 1948 میں انکی گرفتاری کے لئے چھاپے مارے جا رہے تھے وہ اپنے ایک مسلم لیگی دوست کے گھر چھپے رہے پھر خان قیوم کی انتقامی کارروائیوں سے بچنے کے لئے ایک دن بھارت چلے گئے اور کبھی واپس نہیں آئے Video — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/HamidMirPAK/status/2082572515960881358#m

Under the Aspirational Districts and Aspirational Blocks Programmes, Parvathipuram Manyam district, Andhra Pradesh, is preserving and promoting the rich legacy of Savara Art (Edisinge), one of the State's oldest indigenous tribal art forms deeply rooted in the traditions of the Savara community. The initiative focuses on reviving authentic Savara paintings, empowering tribal artisans, nurturing young artists, and creating stronger market linkages through exhibitions, handicrafts, and tourism. By promoting sustainable livelihoods while preserving a unique cultural heritage, the initiative is helping safeguard this timeless art form for future generations. In Baikunthpur Aspirational Block of Korea district, Chhattisgarh, education is being enriched through "Beyond the Classroom with the Collector – The Collector's-15," a mentorship initiative that encourages leadership, confidence, and holistic learning among students. As part of the inaugural Dreamers-15 cohort, 15 students participated in an immersive mentorship programme, engaging in discussions on leadership, aspirations, values, and personal growth while developing a deeper appreciation for their families and the rich cultural heritage of Chhattisgarh. The initiative also introduced students to the traditional Godna Art through a hands-on workshop led by an artisan recognised by the Ministry of Textiles, fostering pride in India's indigenous tribal art and cultural traditions. Dr. R. Balasubramaniam, Member, NITI Aayog, has authored an opinion piece highlighting the significance of developing a Gross Domestic Knowledge Product (GDKP) as a measure of India's knowledge capital. He notes that this initiative by the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI) offers an opportunity to recognise knowledge in all its forms, from scientific research and innovation to traditional wisdom, craftsmanship, and indigenous practices. Emphasising that knowledge extends beyond what can be measured through conventional economic indicators, he advocates for a framework that values both codified and living knowledge systems. Such an approach, he argues, can better inform public policy while preserving and promoting India's rich civilisational heritage. Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif's Message on the Occasion of World Day Against Trafficking in Persons, 30 July 2026. Pakistan joins the international community in observing the World Day against Human Trafficking with a renewed resolve to continue our collective efforts, with unwavering determination, to combat this grave global crime. Human trafficking is not merely a transnational crime, it is one of the most serious and organised violations of human rights. It is a global menace that transcends national borders and exploits social vulnerabilities and human suffering. This heinous crime can only be effectively countered through a united, steadfast and comprehensive strategy at both the national and international levels. Its complete eradication demands a multidimensional approach encompassing robust legal, social, administrative, governmental and community level measures. Human trafficking is intrinsically linked to other forms of organised crime, including irregular migration, forged travel documents, money laundering and forced labour. Addressing the complex causes and manifestations of this crime requires close coordination and collaboration among all relevant national institutions. The Government has devised a comprehensive strategy aimed at proactively dismantling human trafficking networks across the country. In particular, law enforcement agencies, especially the Federal Investigation Agency (FIA), have been equipped with preventive mechanisms to detect and disrupt trafficking activities before they occur. Furthermore, Pakistan continues to strengthen national and international cooperation in combating human trafficking through close coordination with provincial governments, local law enforcement agencies and international partners, including INTERPOL, the United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime (UNODC), and the competent authorities of other countries. In addition, specialised training is being provided to the FIA's Anti-Human Trafficking Units to ensure that victims are treated with compassion, dignity and respect, while perpetrators are brought to justice in accordance with the law. However, eliminating the scourge of human trafficking requires not only sustained state action but also the active cooperation, awareness and sense of responsibility of every citizen. On this World Day, I urge every Pakistani to remain vigilant and assist in identifying individuals and networks involved in human trafficking. We must also pay particular attention to vulnerable and disadvantaged segments of society to ensure that they do not fall prey to exploitative elements. Civic responsibility demands that any suspicious activity be reported immediately through the FIA's helplines or relevant reporting portals so that timely action can be taken against criminal elements. Victims of human trafficking are not criminals; they are victims of exploitation who deserve protection, compassion, psychological support and dignified reintegration into society. The Government remains committed to ensuring that state institutions provide them with the legal protection, psychosocial assistance and rehabilitation services necessary to rebuild their lives with dignity. Let us reaffirm our collective commitment and work together to build a Pakistan where human trafficking is eradicated and where our youth have abundant opportunities for employment, prosperity and a secure future.

Aaditya Mattoo is Director of the Development Research Group at the @WorldBankGroup, where he specialises in development, trade, and international cooperation, and advises governments on policy. He has previously served as Chief Economist of the World Bank's East Asia and Pacific Region, Co-Director of the World Development Report 2020 on Global Value Chains, and Research Manager for Trade and International Integration. China controls almost all the world's rare-earth magnets. Every EV motor on the road today needs one. A few Indian teams decided not to fight that battle at all. Chara Technologies is shipping 20kW reluctance motors: no rare earth, no magnet, no import dependency, with 45kW versions already in R&D and export orders coming in. Vimag Labs has patented its own magnet-free motor platform and is running pilots with two- and three-wheeler makers. Ola Electric certified its own in-house ferrite motor, built without the rare-earth magnets everyone assumes are non-negotiable. There's still a gap to close: these motors give up some torque compared to rare-earth designs. Labs like IIT Madras and ARCI are working on it. But the direction is clear: instead of racing China for a resource it controls, Indian companies are redesigning the machine so the resource doesn't matter. indiaBUILD will identify and speak about such chokepoints - to drive conversations, policy and action needed to counter them. @indiaBUILDwiki

Y'know, peace and love to my fellow stinky nerds, but someone really needs to sit down and explain to people what exact RCE means. The acronym Remote Code Execution implies code (the beep boop stuff) is remotely (far away) executed (ran on the computer). Hence, beep boop stuff that is far away runs on a computer. Historically an RCE is like, your computer is running Soup Goop server, and Soup Goop server fails to properly parse data it receives, allowing specially crafted input to trick Soup Goop server to execute code. So, you could like, use Python 3.11 to send some dumb slop to a remote computer address and it'll execute your bad stuff. In this instance (and many other from Steam and malicious mods in general), the idea is that someone operates or possesses a server which, and when a player joins, the video game server syncs data to the newly connected host which pushes a payload to it. In simple language, and as a hypothetical example, I operate Stinky Minecraft server, and if you join Stinky Minecraft server, my Stinky Minecraft server automatically pushes mods to your computer. Stinky Minecraft server does this because it automatically ensures you're compatible with Stinky Minecraft server and we can all play and have fun. However, one day Stinky Minecraft server says, "you need Goop Texture Pack Mod 0.2.1.1 and ... INFORMATION STEALING MALWARE HEHEHEHEHE" and that malware is automatically pushed to your machine (also with Goop Texture Pack Mod 0.2.1.1). Things like this doesn't really fit the category of Remote Code Execution because nothing is being executed remotely as a vulnerability, it requires a victim machine to connect to a malicious host which syncs the payload to the machine. This is closer in terminology to arbitrary code loading, malicious plugin loading, remote installation of untrusted code ... something, I don't know, but it's not an RCE. Overall, this is more or less a fundamental flaw in the design of video game mods because they're not appropriately sandboxed.

La Russie 🇷🇺 mène en ce moment même une attaque massive de drones et de missiles contre l'Ukraine 🇺🇦 Depuis le début de l'année, plus de 1 300 missiles ont été lancés contre l'Ukraine, soit au moins 5 fois plus que le nombre de missiles ASTER fournis à l'Ukraine. Pour rappel, la production française 🇫🇷 est de moins de 100 missiles anti-aériens par mois et les stocks sont probablement inférieurs au millier d'exemplaires. Depuis plusieurs mois, l'Ukraine manque cruellement d'intercepteurs. La quasi-totalité des lanceurs européens (SAMP-T, IRIS-T, NASAMS...) sont vides depuis bien longtemps (et ces batteries ne sont pas vraiment réputées comme très efficaces) et les stocks de PAC-3 sont pratiquement terminés. Depuis le début de l'année, la Russie a donc lancé 40 000 drones d'attaques (70% de Geran et 30% de Gerbera/Parody) et 1 300 missiles de tous types. En termes de production, on parle d'environ 200 missiles russes qui sortent des usines chaque mois et environ 6 000 drones Geran. Avec l'arrivée de plusieurs drones jet, les Geran-4, Geran-5 et Banderol, il devient plus difficile d'intercepter les vagues de drones. C'est donc des centaines de missiles à "bas coût" en plus qui sortent des usines chaque mois. Pendant ce temps en France, on essaie de nous faire croire que nous sommes passés en économie de guerre et que nous suivons en direct les enseignements de la guerre à l'Est…

Yesterday Håkon Måløy, a stinky AI security researcher, unveiled several vulnerabilities with Microsoft Copilot which could hypothetically allow an AI-like worm in Microsoft Office documents. the tl;dr-ish is that if you insert carefully worded instructions, as white-text thus making it invisible to the user, at the end of Microsoft Office documents, Microsoft Copilot will follow the instructions given to it. The problem with this method (as is tradition), is that the text is still visible in the document if highlighted by the user. Hence, doing something as simple as CTRL+A would render the text visible to the user. Regardless, Håkon Måløy successfully appended white text to a Microsoft Office document that halved the values of company data presented in the document. In simple words, the appended white text manipulated company data in the Microsoft Word file. His second proof-of-concept demonstrated appended white texting propagating the appended white text to other Microsoft Office documents, thus making it worm-like (self-propagating). This is an interesting idea and it is an excellent proof-of-concept. However, like many AI vulnerabilities, this relies heavily on social engineering (kind of) where as text is still present in the document, and like many AI vulnerabilities, results may not be consistent depending on how the AI interprets the data. This isn't a diss to Mr. Måløy, I think this is really interesting, unique, and creative, and could potentially have some real world abuse. Simple tricks have proven to be very effective. The nuance is important to emphasize though because non-nerds on social media seem to be under the impression this is Terminator Copilot edition.

Daily Ukraine map thread for Wednesday 29th July 2026 Following yesterday's Russian flag raise in Tors'ke in the Dobropillya direction, another was raised near Svitle today, suggesting the situation for Ukrainian forces here continues to deteriorate. The Kostyantynivka and west of Siversk directions also remain very poor, with little sign of either situation improving. Midstrike continue apace. The Crimea campaign continues to target substations across the occupied peninsula, alongside air defence sites and shipping. At long range, the campaign against Russian refineries with Ryazan and Perm hit today, and Wildberries logistics strikes continue. The Ryazan distribution centre went up in flames today. Regarding Wildberries, as we've discussed in the comments before: the valuable part isn't really the distribution centres or the goods themselves. It's the software, marketplace and distribution network behind them. That infrastructure could continue operating even if sellers simply moved to garages and operated under a different banner. For western folk, think an eBay model. So the objective here is disruption, particularly to the movement of military equipment. Wildberries itself could potentially go bust, but the wider distribution network won't simply disappear, it'll just become far more expensive and slower to operate.

I pretty much agree with everything here Jamie Metzl (@JamieMetzl) I believe the available evidence overwhelmingly points toward a research-related incident in Wuhan as the origin of the COVID-19 pandemic. The U.S. government provided a relatively small amount of funding connected to research at the Wuhan Institute of Virology, and the work explicitly authorized under those grants could not, by itself, have produced SARS-CoV-2. But money is fungible, and the deeper problem was that we were funding research in an institution where we lacked full transparency into what research was being conducted, by whom, and under what conditions. We should never make that mistake again. This matters as we consider broader scientific engagement with China. Collaboration can be enormously valuable, but only when there are enforceable standards of transparency, accountability, biosafety, and access to information. The relationship between scientists, research institutions, and the state in China is fundamentally different from what exists in open democratic societies. We cannot pretend otherwise. I also believe Dr. Anthony Fauci was wrong to argue so forcefully in the early months of the pandemic that the evidence favored a natural origin. As a Democrat and former member of a WHO expert advisory committee, it was clear to me in early 2020 that no one outside China had enough reliable information to reach a confident conclusion about origins. I believed then, as I do now, that a research-related origin demanded serious investigation. But accountability is not the same as vilification. Dr. Fauci has devoted his career to public health, and his work has helped save millions of lives around the world. He does not deserve the abuse and partisan attacks directed at him in today’s Senate hearing. He does deserve, like every official involved in the pandemic response, rigorous scrutiny of decisions that may have been mistaken. The Chinese government bears overwhelming responsibility for obstructing the world’s ability to understand how this catastrophe began, and that must remain the central focus of any serious origins investigation. But examining China’s failures cannot absolve us of examining our own. We should not have funded potentially risky research in laboratories where we could not demand full transparency, and U.S. officials should not have expressed confidence about pandemic origins that the available evidence did not justify. For six years, I have called for a bipartisan national commission on COVID-19. We still need one. I served as the lead Democrat on the Heritage Foundation’s COVID-19 commission, chaired by John Ratcliffe. That work can provide a starting point, but it cannot substitute for the comprehensive national reckoning we still have not had. Five years after the pandemic ended millions of lives and transformed billions more, this should not be about protecting political tribes, institutions, or reputations. It should be about finding the truth. We need to over every stone, follow the evidence wherever it leads, learn from China’s failures and our own, and then use those lessons to prepare for the next pandemic—which could be far worse than COVID-19 and could arrive sooner than we think. — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/JamieMetzl/status/2082491280463138822#m

250,000 books. That is how many my Ukrainian publisher, Knygolove knigolove.ua/ lost on 19 July after three Russian Iskander missiles struck the warehouse outside Kyiv. Among them were my books, too. This is war, and war inevitably brings human and material losses. But when books burn, it is not just paper that burns. Culture, memory, and identity burn with them. So does a nation’s right to grow and shape its own future. That is why burning books has always meant far more than destroying merchandise. I have waived my royalties for the next year to help support my publisher. I encourage you to buy Ukrainian books—as a gesture of solidarity with Ukrainians fighting, among other things, for the right to read books in their own language. Books survive as long as there are people to print them and people to read them.

Submarine retirement becomes obvious if you sail on one of these old girls. Bear in mind, a nuke sub is as complex as a Space Shuttle. The number of moving parts is in the hundreds of thousands. Each one undergoing wear and tear. You keep a log of what is broken (or "broke-dick" as we would say). The OOC or out-of-commission log. There's also a RS reduced status log, when something just isn't working up to snuff (like your wife that 4 days a month). As a boat ages, those logs grow to dozens, perhaps hundreds, of pages. When we're about to go into a shipyard "availability" like an overhaul or an SRA (shipyard restricted availability), we put together "work packages" to tell the shipyard what to fix. You prioritize - if you made work packages of everything broke-dick, the overhaul would take decades. So you live with things that are off. Like driving with a check-engine light. Some stuff you try to fix with the crew ("ship's force"). Let's not forget that repairs do not always fix things. Often, coming out of a shipyard overhaul, there's more things on the OOC and RS lists than when we went in. It's up to ship's force to fix the shipyard's screwups. So, 40 years in? No matter how much care and maintenance you do to a submarine, it's just tired. To many things and too many systems are running sub-optimal. Eventually, you can't slap a. Band-aid on it anymore. It's just time to move on. Move on and construct a new one. Remember also that the more stuff breaks or runs in reduced status, the louder the boat gets. As acoustic emissions grow, stealth goes out the window. Hence, today I'm shaving with razor blades made from the hulls of Cold War-winning submarines. It's sad, but a boat has a life cycle like any living creature. And that's why Daddy has to buy us a new one.

On October 25, 1994, the first female fighter pilot certified for combat in the U.S. Military, Kara Hultgreen, crashes her F-14A while on approach to USS Abraham Lincoln and is killed. Hultgreen discovers while on approach that she is overshooting the centerline of the landing area. She inputs left rudder pedal to correct her approach. The yawing motion disrupts airflow to the left wing and engine of the aircraft, which suffers a compressor stall and loses power causing asymmetric thrust. This was a well known issue with the F-14. Hultgreen abandons the approach and selects full afterburner on the remaining engine causing even more asymmetric thrust that the control surfaces of the aircraft cannot overcome. This causes the left wing to stall and a rapid turn to the water. The RIO in the rear seat, Lt. Matthew Klemish, initiates the ejection sequence. As the RIO is ejected first in the sequence, Klemish is ejected first and almost parallel with the water. He survives the ejection. Hultgreen is not as fortunate. As the plane is rapidly rolling left, by the time her seat ejects from the aircraft 0.4 seconds later it is too late. Lt. Kara Hultgreen is ejected downward into the water and killed instantly. She is found 3,700 feet below on the sea floor, still strapped into her ejection seat and recovered on November 12. The second half of the video shows her destroyed F-14A as it too is recovered from the sea floor off of San Diego.

اس خوفناک جرم کی انکوائری بھی تبسم نامی لڑکی کو ناانصافی و ظلم سے نہ بچا سکی سی سی ڈی تھانہ دانہ منڈی کے افسر ASI عظمت سے جب پہلے فون پر تبسم گھر ریڈ کرنے اور اسے غیر قانونی حراست میں لینے متعلق جب سوال کیا گیا تو انکا کہنا تھا انہوں نے کسی خاتون کو گرفتار نہ کیا ہے جبکہ ساتھ ہی تبسم کے گھر والوں کو دھمکیاں دینا شروع کر دیں کہ اگر اب آپ میڈیا والوں پاس گئے تو ہم تبسم کو کسی مقدمہ میں پھنسا کر ساری عمر جیل میں ڈال دیں گے یا ہاف فرائی کر دیں گے بعد ازاں جب لڑکی کی غیر قانونی حراست کا معاملہ ڈی آئی جی سہیل ظفر چٹھہ کے نوٹس میں لایا گیا تو انہوں نے اس پر انکوائری کے احکامات جاری کردیے ان احکامات کے بعد سی سی ڈی تھانہ شیخو پورہ نے ایک بار پھر مغویہ تبسم کی فیملی سے رابطہ کیا کہ تبسم تین مقدمات میں ملوث ہے اور شناخت پریڈ پر جیل میں ہے سی سی ڈی نے تبسم کی فیملی کو یہ بھی بتایا کہ تبسم ایک گھر میں اپنے مسلع ڈکیت ساتھیوں ساتھ ایک گھر میں دروازہ پر دستک دے کر اندر داخل ہوئی اور سونا و نقدی چھینی اور گھر کی خواتین پر تشدد کیا بعد ازاں جو سی سی ڈی نے جو ڈکیتی کا مقدمہ درج کیا اس میں مسلع ڈکیتوں کو دیواریں پھلانگ کر گھر میں داخل ہونا شو کیا مزید یہ بھی انکشاف ہوا کہ تبسم کی شادی ایک ڈکیت شاہد سے ہوئی جس کا اسکو علم نہ تھا بعد ازاں علم ہونے پر تبسم نے سی سی ڈی کو اطلاع دے کر خود شاہد کو گرفتار کروایا جسے سی سی ڈی نے نو ماہ قبل خانقاہ ڈوگرہ میں ایک مقابلے میں فل فرائی کر دیا تھا پھر ابھی حال ہی میں بیس دن پہلے شاہد کے دو دوست قسم اور کاکا تبسم کے گھر آئے جس پر سی سی ڈی نے دو ریڈ کیے اور پہلی چار نوجوانوں کو گرفتار کیا اور پھر تبسم کو گرفتار کر کے نامعلوم مقام پر منتقل کر دیا سی سی ڈی نے دو نوجوانوں وسیم و ایک اور کو رشوت لے کر رہا کر دیا جبکہ تبسم و شاہد کے دو دوستوں کو 🤝 CM Devendra Fadnavis presided over the signing and exchange of 3 MoUs at the programme organized on the occasion of 'International Tiger Day 2026' in Nagpur, today. A total of 11 MoU's were exchanged in the programme. Following MoUs were exchanged: 🔸Tadoba-Andhari Tiger Conservation Foundation (TATRCF) and Airbnb India Pvt. (2/2) @DanielYergin: There are two other factors that really stand out. One is a dramatic change in the position of the United States as an energy producer, and in particular, its ability to export not only oil but oil products like jet fuel, like diesel, like gasoline. But I think the biggest surprise here of all this is the response of China, which replaced the United States as the world's largest importer of oil, and they cut their imports almost in half, and I'd have to say no one could see that coming.

Why has this crisis not been worse? (1/2) @DanielYergin: First of all, you're right. We had the oil hit $120 a barrel roughly in 2008, and if you adjust for inflation, that's a higher price. But that was not really based upon any disruption. Obviously, what you're looking at here is the number one maritime choke point in the world, which is the Strait of Hormuz. Why it's not been worse is because the disruption has not been quite on the scale that people thought it would be. Some supplies did get through. The Saudis had built a pipeline system in the 1980s, so they could move their supplies out. The UAE has a pipeline; it can move half of its supplies out. There are strategic stocks, which mean government-controlled stocks in the U.S., called the Strategic Petroleum Reserve. Some oil was released from there.

What does this crisis mean for the world? @DanielYergin: Well, I think first of all, it's the biggest crisis since the Second World War, which was actually, among many other crises, an energy crisis. But certainly in modern times, the reason is because the Middle East is so central. Because 20% of world oil, 20% of LNG, flows through the Strait of Hormuz, and it turns out it's not just an energy crisis. It also involves helium. It involves fertilizer. The products that will not be made because of the crisis will hit agriculture. So this is a seismic event for not only world energy, but for the world economy.

व्याघ्र संवर्धनात महाराष्ट्राची बुलंद झेप, आधुनिक तंत्रज्ञानाने मानव-वन्यजीव संघर्ष रोखण्यावर भर मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांची आज नागपूर येथे 'आंतरराष्ट्रीय व्याघ्र दिन 2026' निमित्त आयोजित कार्यक्रम येथे प्रमुख उपस्थिती दर्शवली. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, अन्नसाखळीत वाघांचे अनन्यसाधारण महत्त्व आहे. त्यामुळे गेल्या 30 वर्षांपासून व्याघ्र संवर्धनासाठी विविध उपक्रम राबवण्यात येत आहेत. महाराष्ट्रात वैज्ञानिक दृष्टिकोनातून व्याघ्र संवर्धनाचे कार्य सुरू असून ते अधिक बळकट करण्यासाठी राज्य सरकार सातत्याने प्रयत्नशील आहे. वन विभागाच्या पुढाकाराने व्याघ्र प्रकल्प परिसरातील नागरिक पुनर्वसनाच्या कामात स्वयंस्फूर्तीने सहभागी होत आहेत. मानव-वन्यजीव संघर्ष कमी करण्यासाठी व्याघ्र प्रकल्पालगतच्या गावांमध्ये नियोजनबद्ध उपाययोजना केल्या जात आहेत. वाघांच्या हालचालींवर लक्ष ठेवण्यासाठी कॅमेरा ट्रॅकिंगसह विविध आधुनिक उपाययोजना राबविण्यात येत आहेत. तसेच, एआय आधारित अर्ली वॉर्निंग सिस्टिमचाही प्रभावी वापर करण्यात येत असल्याचे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी नमूद केले. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, व्याघ्र प्रकल्प ही केवळ वन विभागाची जबाबदारी नसून, व्याघ्र संवर्धनासाठी समाजातील सर्व घटकांनी एकत्रितपणे योगदान देण्याची गरज आहे. देशातील व्याघ्र प्रकल्पांची संख्या वाढली आहे. तसेच कोअर क्षेत्रही वाढत आहेत. आंतरराष्ट्रीय व्याघ्र दिनाची संकल्पना मांडल्यानंतर वाघांची संख्या वाढवण्याचे निर्धारित ध्येय फक्त भारत व नेपाळ या दोनच देशांनी साध्य केले आहे. जगातील एकूण वाघांपैकी सुमारे 75% वाघ व्याघ्र संवर्धनासाठी सीएसआर निधी उपलब्ध करून देण्यासाठी सीएसआर धोरण आखणे, शाश्वत पर्यटन धोरण तयार करून रोजगार निर्मिती करणे आणि पर्यटन वाढवतांना वनसंरक्षण व संवर्धनासाठी आवश्यक निधी उपलब्ध करून देणे Iran's latest ballistic missile attacks and the continued rejection of compromise solutions on the Strait of Hormuz might seem like indications that "hardline" thinking is dominating Iran's national security strategy. But my conversations with counterparts in Tehran suggest that something else is at play. Iranian decisionmaking is increasingly shaped by an intense pessimism about what diplomacy with the U.S. can achieve. Most senior figures, whether pragmatists or hardliners, simply do not believe a deal is possible. This pessimism has gotten worse since the MOU was signed. Part of this is about the repeated experience of U.S. escalation during the course of negotiations, but the pessimism is no longer confined to the question of "does Trump want a deal?" Increasingly the belief is that "Trump can't do a deal, even if he thinks he wants one." Policymakers in Tehran are looking at several things. At a technical level, the Trump administration was unable to execute even the most basic confidence building measures of the MOU. No assets were released and the oil waiver was never really operationalized. Iranian leaders are also looking to other contexts. Even in Venezuela, where the administration has complete political control and a full court press approach to economic reengagement, sanctions relief has floundered (eg. it took a whole month after the massive earthquake for FinCen to take proactive steps to try and provide banks comfort to support humanitarian transactions). At a political level, the Iranians have seen the overblown reaction to the MOU from the full range of politicians in Washington. Democrats eager to score political points attacked provisions in the MOU that would be fundamental to *any* viable agreement with Iran. The Iranians are also watching the growing rift between the Rubio and Vance camps and are concluding that the administration is inherently dysfunctional. During the Biden years, the issue was whether the president could defend his deal from political rivals in Congress. Now, the rivals are within the cabinet itself. At an individual level, there is also a growing sense that Trump is too erratic to stick by his own deals. Even Saudi Arabia, the country with perhaps the greatest influence in the White House after Israel, could not shield its own nuclear deal from Trump's excessive demands. This may be an unprecedented situation. The U.S. has started a war it does not know how to end. Meanwhile, the arguments for diplomacy in Tehran have been reduced to "this has a low chance of succeeding, but we have to still try." That's not a strong, positive case for diplomatic engagement and understandably the strategic thinking is tending towards the idea that U.S. dysfunction will continue to manifest in the form of economic pressure and kinetic action against Iran for a long time to come.

What does it look like when a foreign government buys a president? It looks like this. Qatar handed Donald Trump a $400 million luxury jet. He toured it, fell in love, and decided it was going to be his new Air Force One. Then he demanded the new Qatar Force One be ready for America’s 250th birthday, no matter the cost. The Founders saw this danger coming. That’s why they wrote the Foreign Emoluments Clause into the Constitution. A president is not supposed to accept lavish gifts from a foreign government without Congress’s consent. The entire purpose is to prevent foreign governments from gaining influence over the President of the United States. We were already paying for two brand-new Air Force One jets. That Boeing program has ballooned to roughly $5.7 billion and is years behind schedule. Instead of waiting, taxpayers spent about another $400 million retrofitting Qatar’s aircraft, with hundreds of millions more for training, support aircraft, and logistics. Even worse, the Pentagon financed much of that work through classified accounts, making it far harder for Congressional appropriators like me to follow the money and exercise the oversight the Constitution requires. Let’s be clear about ownership. Qatar supplied the plane. The American people paid hundreds of millions to rebuild it. It belongs to the American people, not Donald Trump. And according to the administration’s own plan, after Trump leaves office, Qatar Force One is supposed to be transferred to his presidential library. That means taxpayers could spend hundreds of millions upgrading a plane from a foreign government only for it to end up under the control of Trump’s library. If that doesn’t demand congressional scrutiny, what does? The rush to put it into service also came at a price. The aircraft entered service without some defensive systems presidential aircraft have relied on for decades, then had to be pulled back out of service for additional upgrades that should have been completed before it ever carried the President. The American people deserve a full public accounting of every dollar spent on this aircraft. No more hiding costs in classified budgets. No more stonewalling Congress. No more treating taxpayer dollars like a personal slush fund.

1. As Parliament debates the Anti-Paper Leak Bill, #CutTheClutter details how the CJP protest unfolded in Delhi on 20 July. This episode explains the instances of lathi-charge, tear gas shelling & pellet firing, the claims & what the probe has revealed so far. It also looks at RAF protocol, & the questions that have emerged over crackdown on protesters. 2. Around 11.35am, police carried out the first lathi-charge. This was near Parliament Street Police Station. Here some protesters tried to push through barricades that were welded together. The barricades were breached. There are also claims that people at the front carried lathis & all may not have belonged to the main CJP group. 3. At 12.11pm, another lathi-charge followed. This time, the RAF was involved along with Delhi Police after protesters reportedly tried to bypass barricades through adjoining govt premises. At the same time, hundreds of protesters broke through barricades & reached right outside the Parliament complex near the Central Secretariat Police Station. That’s where tear gas was used. 4. Between 3.30pm & 4.30pm is the key period. In the stretch between Palika Bazaar & Sansad Marg is where pellet guns were fired. Police records show 55 non-electrical shells, 15 electrical shells & 5 tear-smoke grenades were fired by 1 RAF unit. From the same unit, 2 rounds of a pellet gun were also fired. There are 5 identified victims as of now. The ammunition mentioned in the entry at Parliament Street pertains only to what was used in that area. 5. The RAF is not an ordinary police unit. It is a specialised riot-control wing of the CRPF, created in 1992 & designed for rapid deployment during serious public-order situations. Each company of the RAF is issued 2 pellet guns. But the use has to be authorised. The diary entry shows somebody authorised use. RAF says it’s not them & they’ve taken the constable off duty. 6. Delhi being a Police Commissionerate, its police officers have executive magistrate’s powers & they can authorise use of force. So, DCP (North Delhi), for example, who was in charge authorised the use of force. He did not specifically say fire the pellet guns, but said adequate force should be used for riot control. 7. A 22-year-old architectural weakness in Baseboard Management Controllers (BMCs) is currently exposing over 24,000 servers to critical risk. 🚨 As @KevinSurace, CEO at @Token, notes in today's @SCMagazine article: “For an attacker, compromising the BMC is close to gaining physical access to the server, often beneath the visibility of endpoint security tools.” 🔐 The danger isn’t just in the code; it’s in the neglect. Many BMCs are configured once and then forgotten, sitting outside normal OS security programs. This allows attackers to take password hashes offline, bypassing login alerts entirely, and gain extraordinary control—from shutting down systems to establishing persistence beneath the operating system. 💻 This is a stark reminder that hardware-level security cannot be an afterthought. Проєкт Miya обіцяв людям 0,9% прибутку щодня та працював за принципом класичної фінансової піраміди. Коли почалися проблеми з виведенням грошей, намальовані цифри в особистих кабінетах автоматично перетворили на нову криптовалюту Eva і завели її на біржу Coinsbit. На Coinsbit показували курс: 1 Eva = 1 долар. Водночас, за даними слідства (інформація доступна у реєстрі судових рішень), реальна вартість однієї Eva не перевищувала 0,0005 долара, а більшість інших криптобірж узагалі не приймали цей токен. Тобто курс штучно завищили щонайменше у 2000 разів. 20 березня 2021 року виведення заблокували. Понад 55 тисяч учасників фактично втратили можливість повернути вкладені кошти. Слідство стверджувало, що Удянський вступив у змову з організаторами Miya, погодив штучно завищений курс Eva, знав про викуп ордерів для імітації ліквідності та отримував відсоток від коштів, залучених у фінансову піраміду. А є ще історія про Qmall. Мені пишуть сотні повідомлень люди, яких Удянський кинув на гроші з ще однією біржею. Що маємо у підсумку? Jensen Huang was asked about the people technology left behind. He didn't offer a plan. He said the gap already closed. Huang: "All of a sudden artificial intelligence closed that technology divide." That divide was never a gap in ability. It was a language requirement. Huang: "Anybody could be a software programmer now." Every tool we ever built charged admission, and the price was always a language. The press needed literacy. The engine needed the manual. The computer needed code. Every tool in history had the same shape. The human moved toward the machine, compressed into a form it could parse. Whoever couldn't compress stayed outside. Code was always a human speaking machine. Seventy years of people translating themselves down into something a processor would accept. It just learned to speak back. Nothing has ever moved in that direction before. So we sorted people by the toll and pretended we were sorting by mind. The ones who paid became skilled. Everyone else became unskilled, a word that has never once described a real person. It only meant fluent in nothing the market was buying. Huang: "Everybody who are really gifted at their craft but maybe they don't know how to scale themselves with technology, they now have AI to help scale them." The best cook in a village of four thousand died the best cook in a village of four thousand. Not from a shortage of ability, but from a second requirement that had nothing to do with the first. Go back far enough in your own family and there is someone who was extraordinary at something. The world never found out. Neither did they. Ability was never distributed by geography. Access was, and access is the only thing that got recorded. Every system you move through in a day was built by the narrow band who could speak to a machine. Not the best ideas anyone had. The ideas that survived translation. We have never once seen what the rest of the species would have made. The scarcity was never in the talent. It was in the distance between holding it and reaching anyone. That distance was the product the technology industry sold. Huang: "They're welcomed into the world's economy, not burdened by technology anymore because AI made that possible." Burdened. Technology sold itself as leverage for a century, and the man supplying the whole industry just called it a weight. A developer you couldn't afford. A site that broke on a Sunday with no one to call. You paid the technology industry for permission to be findable. Nobody on earth got smarter this decade. The door stopped asking for a password. Huang: "Five years from now, it is likely that we're all going to be more gainfully employed. The economy is gonna be more productive." He grounds that in the labor shortage already on the books. Open work with nobody there to do it, inside an economy panicking about a machine that takes work away. Both cannot be true. The fear says there won't be enough work for us. The ledger says there aren't enough of us for the work. Every time a tool stopped requiring a specialist, the specialist lost a monopoly and everyone else gained a century. Writing left the scribes. The press left the church. The computer left the lab. The barrier was also a shelter. Everyone left outside got to keep the version of themselves that was never tested. For most of history that was a mercy. The wall did the refusing, so you never had to hear it from anyone else. The wall is gone. Now you find out. Nothing about you changed. The requirement did. For the first time, the only thing between what you can do and who it reaches is whether you do it. Video

His Excellency Sheikh Jarrah Jaber Al-Ahmad Al-Sabah, Minister of Foreign Affairs of the State of Kuwait, called on Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif. Islamabad, 29 July 2026.

Islamabad: 29 July 2026. His Excellency Sheikh Jarrah Jaber Al-Ahmad Al-Sabah, Minister of Foreign Affairs of the State of Kuwait, called on Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif today. Deputy Prime Minister & Foreign Minister Senator Mohammad Ishaq Dar, along with the Federal Ministers for Defence, Commerce, National Food Security & Research, Communications, Maritime Affairs, and Petroleum, the Adviser to the Prime Minister, and senior government officials, were also present. During the cordial meeting, the Prime Minister warmly welcomed the Kuwaiti Foreign Minister and conveyed his best wishes to the Amir of Kuwait, His Highness Sheikh Meshal Al-Ahmad Al-Jaber Al-Sabah, and the Crown Prince, His Highness Sheikh Sabah Al-Khaled Al-Hamad Al-Mubarak Al-Sabah. Recalling the longstanding fraternal relations between Pakistan and Kuwait, founded on shared values and mutual trust, the Prime Minister observed that the two brotherly countries had always stood together through thick and thin. While exchanging views on the regional situation, the Prime Minister reaffirmed Pakistan’s full solidarity with the leadership and people of Kuwait and strongly condemned the attacks on Kuwait and other brotherly Gulf countries during the ongoing conflict. He stated that Pakistan was playing its part as an honest and sincere mediator and facilitator in the regional peace efforts and thanked the Kuwaiti leadership for its support for these efforts. On bilateral relations, the Prime Minister expressed satisfaction over the positive trajectory of ties and reaffirmed Pakistan’s commitment to further strengthening cooperation with Kuwait in diverse fields, including trade, investment, energy, agriculture, information technology, maritime affairs, and human resource development. He also appreciated the Kuwaiti Government for generously hosting the Pakistani community and acknowledged its valuable contribution to Kuwait’s socio-economic development. Foreign Minister Al-Sabah conveyed the greetings and best wishes of the Kuwaiti leadership to the Prime Minister and reaffirmed Kuwait’s commitment to further enhancing bilateral cooperation across areas of mutual benefit. He also expressed deep appreciation for the valuable contributions made by Pakistan, particularly by the Prime Minister, Deputy Prime Minister & Foreign Minister Senator Mohammad Ishaq Dar, and Field Marshal Syed Asim Munir, in advancing dialogue and diplomacy to resolve the current crisis and restore peace to the region. He further thanked Pakistan’s leadership and people for their solidarity and steadfast support for Kuwait during these difficult times. The two sides emphasized the importance of continued consultation and coordination on issues of mutual interest, particularly in the bilateral context, and agreed to exchange delegations in the near future to carry these discussions forward. In this regard, the Prime Minister reiterated his invitation to His Highness the Crown Prince of Kuwait to undertake an official visit to Pakistan at a mutually convenient time. Video

American mathematician John Pardon, one of the winners of this year's Fields Medal, is proficient in Chinese. He once won an award in the "Chinese Bridge" competition while studying at Princeton University. He learned Chinese simply out of personal interest. "The reason I chose Chinese is the writing system is the hardest of all the possible options I had," he said. Fueled by his passion, he has achieved near-native proficiency, reciting The Analects, debating fluently in Chinese, and performing pingshu, a popular Chinese form of storytelling monologue. As some people deliberately build academic and cultural barriers, this year's Fields Medal has given a counterargument: A scholar who truly drives human progress has not been bounded by country borders and ideology. This shows that openness, inclusiveness, and mutual learning are the right paths for the development of science and civilization. When the world's smartest young people take the initiative to study the Chinese language, it perfectly highlights China's growing global appeal. Exchanges and mutual learning among civilizations will always be better than confrontation and division.

⚠️ Monero + Tor : une faille réseau vient d’être exposée !! Le Monero Research Lab se réunit demain 29 juillet pour en discuter... Monero est conçu pour cacher : 👉 qui envoie 👉 qui reçoit 👉 et combien Pour protéger aussi l’adresse IP de l’utilisateur, beaucoup de gens (et de nœuds) font passer leurs transactions via Tor Le paper montre qu’il existe une faille au niveau du réseau (pas dans la cryptographie de Monero elle-même) quand on utilise Tor avec Monero Explication... Quand un nœud Monero tourne derrière Tor : ➡️ Il crée une adresse oignon (hidden service) ➡️ Quand il veut envoyer une transaction, il ne la diffuse pas directement sur internet clair ➡️ Il l’envoie d’abord uniquement à deux nœuds Tor proxy (des hidden services sortants) avant que la transaction ne passe sur le réseau Monero normal (clearnet) C’est une particularité de la façon dont Monero gère les connexions Tor Un attaquant peut : 👉 Prendre la place de ces deux connexions sortantes du nœud cible 👉 Capturer les transactions qui sortent de ce nœud 👉 Puis utiliser une technique appelée watermarking (marquage du trafic) pour lier l’adresse oignon Tor à la vraie adresse IP de la machine Ils appellent leur méthode ProxyMark Elle se déroule en trois étapes : ➡️ Identifier le rôle des nœuds (qui est un proxy, qui est un client, etc.) ➡️ Capturer les transactions qui originent du nœud cible ➡️ Dé-anonymiser la localisation (trouver l’IP réelle) Les auteurs ont testé leur attaque sur : 👉 le réseau Tor réel 👉 le mainnet Monero 👉 et le testnet Résultats rapportés : Identification des adresses oignon : 100% de précision ‼️ Occupation des connexions sortantes : Très efficace (7 à 11 sur 12 connexions selon les conditions) Watermarking : 100% de précision et plus de 91-93% de rappel Autrement dit, dans les conditions de leurs expériences, l’attaque fonctionne très bien ! 👉 Ça ne casse pas les ring signatures, les stealth addresses ni RingCT 👉 Ça ne permet pas de lire le contenu des transactions Monero 👉 Ça ne dé-anonymise pas les utilisateurs qui n’utilisent pas Tor de cette façon (ou qui utilisent Tor correctement avec d’autres précautions) C’est une attaque réseau... elle exploite la façon dont Monero et Tor interagissent ensemble, pas la crypto on-chain Le Monero Research Lab en discute demain 29 juillet Ils vont regarder s’il faut changer quelque chose dans le code Bref... Dès que deux protocoles se rencontrent, un point faible apparaît souvent 😉 #Monero #Tor #Privacy

Chennai, Tamil Nadu | On EVM reliability verification, District Election Officer Sameeran says, "... The inspection is being carried out to verify the reliability of the Electronic Voting Machines (EVMs). As per the directions of the Election Commission, the Electronic Voting Machines are being verified. Following the inspection of the machines used in the Kolathur constituency, similar inspections will also be carried out in the respective districts for machines used in Kanchipuram and Virudhunagar districts. The machines used in 14 polling stations selected by the candidate are being inspected. The process is being carried out in the presence of the candidate's chief election agent and engineers from Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL). At the outset, the votes already recorded in the machines will be displayed. Thereafter, all the recorded votes will be completely erased, and a mock poll will be conducted. This procedure is intended solely to test the reliability of the voting machines. Initially, the machines used in two polling stations will be inspected today. During the mock poll, a minimum of 500 votes and a maximum of 1,400 votes may be cast. The 14 polling stations selected for the inspection are located in different areas. This is the first time such a verification exercise is being conducted in Chennai."

حکومت کے زیر انتظام نئے قائم کردہ قومی سطح کے مرکزی ڈیٹا سینٹر sky 47 کی سہولیات تمام وفاقی اداروں کو میسر کرنے کے لیے فوری طور پر موثر اقدامات اٹھائے جائیں۔ وزیرِ اعظم نے کہا کہ پبلک سیکٹر میں قومی سطح پر ایک مربوط ڈیٹا سینٹر ہی تمام اداروں کے ڈیٹا کو مرکوز جگہ فراہم کرے گا اور مختلف اداروں کے علیحدہ علیحدہ ڈیٹا سینٹرز کے قیام کو روکنے سے قومی وسائل کی بچت ہوگی۔ پاکستان ڈیجیٹل اتھارٹی حکومتی خدمات, معاشرتی نظام بالخصوص عوام کو شہری سہولیات کی فراہمی کے لیے فعال مستعد اور انقلابی سمت کا تعین کر رہی ہے۔ وزیرِ اعظم نے مزید کہا کہ عصر حاضر کے تقاضوں کے مطابق قومی ڈیجیٹل ویژن کا اطلاق ایک مربوط معاشرے کی تشکیل میں کلیدی حیثیت رکھتاہے. قومی و مربوط ڈیجیٹل ویژن کے تحت ڈیجیٹل معیشت، ڈیجیٹل شہری سہولیات اور ڈیجیٹل حکومتی خدمات، تین بنیادی ستون پر جاری کام لائق تحسین ہے۔ قومی مربوط ڈیجیٹل پالیسی پر موثر عمل درآمد سے عالمی شراکت داری اور عالمی فورمز پر ملک کی موثر نمائندگی یقینی بنائی جا سکے گی. تمام متعلقہ اداروں اور وفاقی و صوبائی حکومت کی مشاورت سے قومی ڈیجیٹل ویژن پر مکمل عمل درامد سے اداروں کی فیصلہ سازی، کارکردگی اور شفافیت عالمی معیار سے ہم آہنگ ہو جائے گی۔ وزیرِ اعظم نے ہدایت کی کہ قومی ڈیجیٹل ویژن کا اطلاق پہلے ترجیحاتی شعبے بشمول صحت، زراعت، یوٹیلیٹیز، ہاؤسنگ اور (SMEs) چھوٹے اور درمیانے درجے کے صنعتی و تجارتی اداروں کے لئے کیا جائے تاکہ عوام کو بہتر سہولیات جلد از جلد پہنچائی جا سکیں۔ انہوں نے کہا کہ قومی ڈیجیٹل ویژن کے مکمل اطلاق کے بعد شہریوں کو ایک ہی ڈیجیٹل آئی ڈی کے تحت تمام تر عوامی سہولیات بشمول دستاویزات کی حکومتی تصدیق، بنک کی سہولیات، صحت، ٹرانسفرز اور دیگر تمام سہولیات ایک ہی جگہ میسر ہو سکیں گی۔ نیشنل ڈیجیٹل کمیشن کا اجلاس جلد بلایا جائے تاکہ صوبوں سمیت تمام شراکت داروں کو اس پالیسی پر اعتماد میں لیا جائے۔ ڈیجیٹل نیشن پاکستان ایکٹ 2025 کے تحت قائم کردہ نیشنل ڈیجیٹل کمیشن کے سربراہ وزیر اعظم پاکستان ہیں اور تمام صوبائی وزرائے اعلیٰ اسکے ممبران ہیں. اجلاس کو بریفنگ میں بتایا گیا کہ وزیراعظم کی ہدایت کے مطابق قومی ڈیجیٹل ویژن کا اطلاق ،زراعت، خوراک، صحت, انرجی، ہاؤسنگ اور (SMEs) چھوٹے اور درمیانے درجے کے صنعتی و تجارتی اداروں کے شعبوں میں کیا جا رہا ہے. ان چار شعبوں کے علاوہ دیگر 14 ترجیحاتی سیکٹرز پر وزیراعظم کی ہدایت کے مطابق کام کیا جا رہا ہے جو نہ صرف شعبہ جاتی کارکردگی کو بہتر بنائیں گے بلکہ ملکی معیشت اور اور صنعت اور تجارت میں بھی مثبت اثرات مرتب کریں گے۔ بریفنگ میں مزید بتای گیا کہ ہاوسنگ کے شعبے میں اس کے اطلاق کے بعد نجی و سرکاری تمام املاک کے لیے ایک مرکزی نشاندہی نمبر میسر آ سکے گا۔ ڈیجیٹل نظام کے سمال اینڈ میڈیم انٹرپرائزز کے شعبے میں اطلاق سے کاروبار کی منفرد قانونی شناخت کا ایک مربوط نظام مرتب ہوگا جو ملک کی مجموعی پیداوار میں اضافے کا باعث بنے گا۔ قومی ڈیجیٹل ویژن کے مکمل اطلاق کے لیے تمام قانونی، انتظامی اور ادارہ جاتی اقدامات تیزی سے مکمل کیے جارہے ہیں۔ اس تناظر میں عالمی ماہرین اور عالمی اداروں کی راۓ، اور دنیا میں رائج بہترین طریقوں سے بھی استفادہ حاصل کیا گیا ہے۔ اجلاس میں وفاقی وزیر برائے منصوبہ بندی احسن اقبال، وفاقی وزیر برائے اقتصادی امور احد چیمہ، وفاقی وزیر خزانہ محمد اورنگزیب, وفاقی وزیر برائے کامرس جام کمال خان، وفاقی وزیر قانون اعظم نذیر تارڑ،وفاقی وزیر اطلاعات و نشریات عطاء اللہ I paid my respects to the late Senator Lindsey Graham at a special memorial service in Washington D.C. Received a brief on the progress the Financial Inclusion Fund, popularly known as the Hustler Fund, is making in the lives of customers. We will continue resourcing the fund so that Kenyans can continue accessing the most affordable credit in the country. So far, the Fund has disbursed KSh90 billion to 28 million borrowers on three products - Personal Loan, Bridge Loan and Hustler Groups - and lending KSh50 million a day. Additionally, the Fund has 10 million repeat customers, 4.5 million of whom have good scores of A and B courtesy of their good borrowing and repayment behaviour. The borrowers have saved KSh7 billion, a major achievement in the role the Hustler Fund was meant to play in mobilising national savings. I am very proud that these milestones have been achieved purely on a digital platform and the processes have all been digitised.

Secretary-General of ASEAN, H.E. Dr. Kao Kim Hourn, delivered pre-recorded remarks at the UK-ASEAN Renewable Energy and Interconnection Symposium, held in Jakarta. In his remarks, Dr. Kao highlighted the growing ASEAN-UK partnership in supporting ASEAN's energy transition through the Clean and Just Energy Transition Pillar under the ASEAN-UK Green Transition Fund (GTF). He also underscored ASEAN's energy ambitions under the ASEAN Plan of Action for Energy Cooperation (APAEC) 2026-2030 and emphasised the importance of strengthening regional connectivity and mobilising investment through initiatives such as the ASEAN Power Grid Financing Initiative (APGF) and the Platform for ASEAN Connectivity and Energy (PACE). Recognising the United Kingdom's expertise in offshore transmission, submarine power cable systems, electricity market design, project development, and sustainable finance, he encouraged participants to forge new partnerships and identify concrete actions to accelerate the implementation of the ASEAN Power Grid for a more connected, sustainable, and prosperous ASEAN. کہ مختلف شعبوں میں ٹیکس کی استعداد کے تخمینے کیلئے ایک جامع و سائنٹیفک طریقہ کار وضع کرکے پیش کیا جائے. پاور سیکٹر کے ساتھ تعاون سے غیر رسمی معاشی سرگرمیوں اور ٹیکس چوری میں ملوث افراد و کارباروں کا تعین کرکے انکے خلاف قانونی کاروائی کی جائے. گفتگو کرتے ہوئے وزیرِ اعظم نے کہا کہ پاکستان کی تاریخ میں پہلی مرتبہ چینی کے پیداواری شعبے اور ایف بی آر کے اعداد و شمار میں ہم آہنگی اس بات کا واضح ثبوت ہے کہ ایف بی آر کی جانب سے نصب شدہ ٹریکنگ نظام فعال اور بہتر کارکردگی دکھا رہا ہے. اس ضمن میں چئیرمین ایف بی آر اور انکی ٹیم کی کاوشیں لائق تحسین ہیں. ٹیکس نظام میں رہتے ہوئے تمام تر ضابطوں کی پابندی کرنے اور ٹیکس جمع کروانے والے افراد و کاروبار ملک و قوم کا قیمتی سرمایہ اور لائق تحسین ہیں. وزیرِ اعظم نے مزید کہا کہ حکومت نے ٹیکس کے حوالے سے برآمدی اور مقامی شعبے کو جس قدر ممکن ہوا سہولت فراہم کی اور آئندہ کیلئے بھی کرتی رہے گی. وزیرِ اعظم نے ہدایت کی کہ چیئرمین ایف بی آر اور سینئر افسران ہر ماہ کے پہلے ہفتے کراچی میں موجود ہوں تاکہ کاروباری برادری کے مسائل بروقت سنے اور حل کیے جا سکیں. ٹریکنگ نظام کی تنصیب، ایف بی آر میں افرادی قوت کے حوالے سے نافذ کی گئیں اصلاحات اور آپریشنل استعداد کار بڑھانے کے حوالے سے بریفنگ دی گئی. اجلاس کو بتایا گیا کہ چینی، سیمنٹ، تمباکو، ٹائلز اور کھاد کے Deputy Prime Minister/Foreign Minister Senator Mohammad Ishaq Dar @MIshaqDar50 and H.E. Sheikh Jarrah Jaber Al-Ahmad Al-Sabah, Foreign Minister of the State of Kuwait, co-chaired delegation-level talks at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. The two sides reviewed the entire spectrum of Pakistan–Kuwait bilateral relations and discussed ways to further strengthen cooperation in trade, investment, energy, labour, agriculture, information technology, health, mining and minerals, defence, and the broader economic partnership. They agreed to further institutionalise bilateral cooperation through enhanced institutional linkages and regular high-level exchanges. The two sides also reaffirmed their commitment to close coordination and cooperation at multilateral forums on issues of mutual interest. The Kuwaiti Foreign Minister thanked the Government and people of Pakistan for the warm welcome and gracious hospitality extended to him and his delegation. He also expressed appreciation for Pakistan’s support to Kuwait during the COVID-19 pandemic. The Deputy Prime Minister/Foreign Minister reaffirmed Pakistan’s deep commitment to its longstanding brotherly relations with Kuwait and underscored Pakistan’s desire to further expand the mutually beneficial partnership across all areas of cooperation. The two sides also exchanged views on regional and international developments of mutual interest, including the situation in the Middle East and Palestine. The Kuwaiti Foreign Minister also appreciated Pakistan’s constructive role in promoting regional peace and stability. @MOFAKuwait

Aaditya Mattoo is Director of the Development Research Group at the @WorldBankGroup, where he specialises in development, trade, and international cooperation, and advises governments on policy. He has previously served as Chief Economist of the World Bank's East Asia and Pacific Region, Co-Director of the World Development Report 2020 on Global Value Chains, and Research Manager for Trade and International Integration. Before joining the World Bank, he was Economic Counsellor at the @wto and taught economics at the University of Sussex and Churchill College, University of Cambridge. He holds a Ph.D. in Economics from the University of Cambridge and an M.Phil in Economics from the University of Oxford. We look forward to the depth his expertise in trade, services, and international cooperation will bring to ICRIER's research.

ICRIER is pleased to welcome Prof. Shashwat Alok as a Visiting Professor. Prof. Alok is an Associate Professor of Finance at the Indian School of Business and Research Director of the Digital Identity Research Initiative. His research examines how digital infrastructure, data, fintech, policy, and regulation shape financial markets, expand financial inclusion, and affect firms and households in emerging economies. His recent work studies how fintech, alternative data, and public digital infrastructure can expand credit access, improve risk assessment, and reshape competition between banks and fintech lenders, alongside ongoing research on open banking, Buy Now Pay Later, and financial innovation. His research has been published in leading journals, including the Review of Financial Studies, Management Science, the Journal of Law and Economics, and the Journal of Financial and Quantitative Analysis. His research has informed policy discussions in India, including through the Indian Economic Survey, the Reserve Bank of India’s Household Finance Committee Report, and his participation in pre-Budget consultations with the Prime Minister of India. He holds a PhD in Finance from Washington University in St. Louis and a BE in Computer Science from Manipal University. We look forward to the depth his expertise in fintech, digital infrastructure, and financial inclusion will bring to ICRIER's research.

On this day in 1898, physicist Isidor Isaac Rabi was born! He is most famous for his discovery of nuclear magnetic resonance. Nuclear magnetic resonance is when atomic nuclei in a magnetic field absorb electromagnetic radiation and then re-emit it. The resonance frequency, which are certain oscillations of energy, changes depending on the magnetic field and the properties of the atoms involved. By observing these changing frequencies, scientists can gather information about the chemical and structural details of molecules. Rabi first described and measured nuclear magnetic resonance in molecular beams which was an extension of the Stern–Gerlach experiment. This work earned him the 1944 @NobelPrize in Physics and formed the basis for developing applications using nuclear magnetic resonance like magnetic resonance imaging, or MRI. MRIs are used in medicine for creating high-resolution images of the inside of the human body. These images are used to diagnose a wide range of injuries and diseases, including cancer and cardiovascular disease.

Claire Z., a Canadian researcher of Chinese origin and an intern at NATO’s military headquarters — the Supreme Headquarters Allied Powers Europe (SHAPE) — arrested on suspicions of espionage, is an AI researcher who has previously worked for multiple other international organizations and who might have provided China with sensitive information. Z. arrived in the Belgian town of Mons in July 2025 to begin her internship in SHAPE’s IT department. She extended her initial 6-month term to a year. Just before her internship ended, police raided her student room in Mons and her workplace at NATO on July 23. The next day, Z. was arrested. She is suspected of “espionage on behalf of a third country and participation in a criminal organisation”. Z., who speaks fluent Chinese and English, specializes in AI. In 2022, she obtained a Master’s degree in computer science from a Canadian university and subsequently wrote several academic papers, the most recent of which examined how AI that detects patterns can be better protected against hostile attacks. Canadian authorities had given approval for her internship. “She held a security clearance issued by Canada,” a security official said, adding that while she could have collected some intelligence helpful for Chinese authorities, access to classified information was only shared on a need-to-know basis. Z. came to the attention of SHAPE’s internal counter-intelligence service, which shared the information with the Belgian General Intelligence and Security Service (ADIV) “because it observed that the young Canadian woman was exhibiting behaviour that went beyond that of a mere intern at NATO”. According to another security official, Z. was seen hanging around NATO’s buildings and was frequently asking hypothetical questions about breaches of security protocols. “She displayed suspicious behaviour that was picked up on. Recently, more attention has been paid to the Chinese threat. Perhaps colleagues asked themselves: what is that Chinese woman doing here?” ￼ Interns at SHAPE could gather a significant amount of information that could be of interest to Chinese intelligence services, such as people’s names and identities, internal security procedures, and building plans, as well as routes of guards and locations of CCTV cameras. NATO is not the first European or international organization where Z. has worked. Her social media accounts show that she previously undertook a 10-month internship at the European Space Agency’s (ESA) research centre in Italy. She also worked at the WTO in Switzerland and for various Canadian government organizations. Further investigation will have to determine whether Z. was indeed carrying out intelligence work, and whether this was done on behalf of China. (This would fit into China’s playbook.) “We know that the Chinese government makes extensive use of its diaspora for espionage and influence operations. At the same time, Beijing can use the fact that she is not Chinese to its advantage. New Working Paper | EU Sustainability Regulations: Implications for India's Rice Exports India is the world's largest rice exporter, accounting for 29% of global exports worth USD 11.8 billion in 2024. The EU is a strategically important market, especially for basmati, but rice was excluded from tariff elimination under the India-EU FTA, leaving India at a price disadvantage against FTA-advantaged competitors like Viet Nam. Meanwhile, over 200 rapid alert notifications against Indian rice in the last five years, mainly for banned pesticide residues, point to widening compliance gaps. Drawing on trade data, RASFF notifications, and firm-level case studies, Arpita Mukherjee and Ria Babbar assess India's rice value chain against the EU's evolving environmental, labour, and corporate-accountability standards. They identify six environmental and four labour risks needing urgent attention, and call for farm-level traceability and use of the India-EU FTA to secure mutual recognition of India's audit and certification systems. The majority of FPO members are women from marginalized communities. The initiative represents an important step towards demonstrating how clean energy, sustainable agriculture, and community ownership can come together to create resilient and inclusive rural livelihoods. It's completely unnecessary to destroy books when machines like this exist. This book scanner by Treventus for example, can scan fragile books without destroying it. Video Hedgie (@HedgieMarkets) 🦔AI companies are bulk-buying rare books, scanning them through high-speed machines that cut the spines off, and shredding the originals. A service called ISBNdb facilitates orders of up to a million books and keeps buyers anonymous. Pre-2022 books are premium because they're free of AI-generated text. A federal judge ruled the practice is fair use because eliminating the original means only one copy exists at a time. Anthropic hired the former head of Google Books partnerships to obtain "all the books in the world." My Take This got to me. A bookseller told 404 Media that rare books with almost no surviving copies are being fed into this pipeline. Books that survived wars, fires, and centuries of handling are being shredded so an AI can learn to write a better marketing email. ISBNdb's website literally says "'AI company destroys two million books' is not a headline that generates sympathy," and they still built an entire business around making it happen quietly. They offer NDAs as a feature. They coach clients to call it "digital preservation." I've covered AI companies scraping the internet, torrenting libraries, and stealing music. This is worse because it's irreversible. You can re-upload a website. You can reprint a bestseller. You can't replace the last three copies of an 18th-century botanical text once someone shreds them for training data. And the judge said it's legal. So it's going to accelerate. "We shred rare books and offer NDAs so nobody finds out" is a legitimate business model in 2026. What a timeline. Hedgie🤗 — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/HedgieMarkets/status/2081534588485296565#m

सामाजिक क्रांति के प्रतिमूर्ति ईश्वरचंद्र विद्यासागर जी की पुण्यतिथि पर उन्हें सादर नमन। बंगाल पुनर्जागरण के महान स्तंभ ईश्वरचंद्र विद्यासागर जी ने शिक्षा को सामाजिक परिवर्तन का सबसे सशक्त माध्यम बनाया। ‘वर्णपरिचय’ की रचना कर उन्होंने बांग्ला भाषा की वर्णमाला को नया स्वरूप दिया और असंख्य युवाओं के लिए ज्ञान का द्वार खोला। बाल विवाह के विरुद्ध आजीवन संघर्ष करने वाले तथा विधवा पुनर्विवाह व स्त्री शिक्षा के प्रबल समर्थक विद्यासागर जी का जीवन प्रेरणीय है। সামাজিক নবজাগরণের অগ্রদূত ঈশ্বরচন্দ্র বিদ্যাসাগরের প্রয়াণ দিবসে তাঁকে জানাই বিনম্র শ্রদ্ধাঞ্জলি। বাংলার নবজাগরণের অন্যতম মহান পুরোধা ঈশ্বরচন্দ্র বিদ্যাসাগর শিক্ষা ব্যবস্থাকে সামাজিক পরিবর্তনের সবচেয়ে শক্তিশালী হাতিয়ার হিসেবে প্রতিষ্ঠিত করেছিলেন। ‘বর্ণপরিচয়’ রচনার মাধ্যমে তিনি বাংলা বর্ণমালাকে নতুন রূপ দেন এবং অগণিত শিক্ষার্থীর জন্য জ্ঞানের দুয়ার উন্মুক্ত করেন। বাল্যবিবাহের বিরুদ্ধে আজীবন সংগ্রাম, বিধবা বিবাহের পক্ষে নিরলস আন্দোলন এবং নারীশিক্ষার প্রসারে তাঁর অসামান্য অবদান আজও আমাদের প্রেরণার উৎস।
